entries.consent.title: Mbere yo gutangira
entries.consent.purpose.ack: Ndumva ko Rinda ari iyo kumenya ibijyanye n'ubuzima bwanjye. Si isuzuma rya muganga kandi si serivisi y'ubutabazi bwihuse.
entries.consent.age.question: Ufite hagati y’imyaka 18 na 35?
entries.consent.age.ineligible: Murakoze ku bw'ubushake bwanyu. Ubu bushakashatsi ni ubw'abantu bafite hagati y'imyaka 18 na 35 gusa, bityo ntushobora gukomeza. Niba ukeneye ubufasha mu by'ubuzima, izi serivisi zirashobora kugufasha.
entries.consent.choices.intro: Hitamo ibyo wemera. Buri cyemezo kirihariye, kandi nta na kimwe twaguhitiyemo.
entries.consent.core.label: Nemeye kwitabira ubushakashatsi bwa Rinda Health
entries.consent.core.body: Ibisubizo byawe bibikwa neza kandi bikoreshwa mu bushakashatsi nta zina ryawe. Ushobora kuva mu bushakashatsi no gusaba ko amakuru yawe asibwa igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
entries.consent.core.required: Ugomba kwemera kwitabira kugira ngo ukoreshe Rinda.
entries.consent.mental_wellness.label: Nemeye gusubiza ibibazo by'imitekerereze n'umunaniro bitari itegeko
entries.consent.mental_wellness.body: Ushobora gusimbuka ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose. Nutabyemera, ibi bibazo ntibizerekanwa.
entries.consent.audio.label: Nemeye ko ikiganiro cy'ubushakashatsi gifatwa amajwi
entries.consent.audio.body: Itsinda ry'ubushakashatsi ni ryo ryonyine ribyumva. Porogaramu ya Rinda ntijya ifata amajwi yawe.
entries.consent.follow_up.label: Nemeye ko bazongera kumvugisha nyuma ku byerekeye ubushakashatsi
entries.consent.follow_up.body: Binyuze gusa kuri imeri cyangwa nimero ya telefoni iri kuri iyi konti.
